# Project overview
submitnow (Bing-only) is a multilingual web UI for submitting URL batches to Bing via the IndexNow protocol. Requests are sent server-side and are not persisted.

# Tech stack
Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, OpenNext Cloudflare, Wrangler.

# Common commands
```bash
pnpm dev
pnpm lint
pnpm build
pnpm deploy
```

# Setup and requirements
- Node.js 20+, pnpm recommended.
- Copy `.env.example` to `.env`.
- IndexNow requirement: host `https://<host>/<key>.txt` with the key as plain text.

# Notes
- Only the Bing endpoint is supported (`https://www.bing.com/indexnow`).
- For public deployments, consider adding auth and rate limiting.
